descriptionParagraphs.text: American Fork resident Daniel Sroka appeared on
to discuss his two meetings with Chief Cameron Paul about the March police encounters involving
Sroka described the chief’s changed assessment of the arrests and search warrant, his acknowledgment of mistakes, and the need for public accountability.
The video also features interviews with plaintiffs Sheldon Norcross and Steven Allen and their attorney, Solomon Radner.

$override.description: Rob Shelton reports on the federal lawsuit filed October 14 by Sheldon Norcross, Tyler Shaw, Sierra Lauts, and Steven Allen against American Fork City and 13 officers. The complaint alleges constitutional violations; these allegations have not been adjudicated. Ben Schneider is not a plaintiff.
